Frederick Christian, Elector of Saxony | Frederick Christian (Polish: "Fryderyk Krystian Wettyn" ; 5 September 1722 – 17 December 1763) was the Prince-Elector of Saxony for fewer than three months in 1763. Nikolaus Krell | Nikolaus Krell (c. 1551 – 9 October 1601), chancellor of the elector of Saxony, was born at Leipzig, and educated at the university of his native town.

Josef A. Käs | Josef A. Käs (born October 14, 1961 in Munich, Germany) is a German biophysicist.  He is a Professor at Leipzig University.

Kjeld Ammentorp | Kjeld Anker Ammentorp (10 November 1895 - 23 October 1975) was the founder of RMC Group, one of the United Kingdom's largest concrete businesses.

In a Brilliant White | In a Brilliant White is the seventh studio album by Norwegian group Fra Lippo Lippi; this time, with vocalist Per Øystein Sørensen as the sole member (as bassist/founder Rune Kristoffersen retired to manage his record label). Heinrich Zimmern | Heinrich Zimmern (14 July 1862 in Graben – 17 February 1931 in Leipzig, 1931) was a German Assyriologist. Josef Dostál (botanist) | Josef Dostál (20 December 1903 – 11 May 1999) was a Czech botanist, pteridologist, conservationist, climber, hiker and university teacher. Sven Oluf Sørensen | Sven Oluf Sørensen (born 26 November 1920, dead 16 September 2017) was a Norwegian physicist.  He was born in Paris, as a son of painter Henrik Sørensen and Gudrun Kleve.
